# IAS Florida

> Licensed HVAC mechanical contractor serving Miami-Dade County, Florida.
> Residential and commercial heating, ventilation, air conditioning and

IAS Florida LLC is the Miami operating subsidiary of Icebox Air Systems LLC.
The team is bilingual (English and Spanish) and EPA 608 certified. Estimates
for new installation and replacement are free and provided in writing before
any work begins.

- Phone: (786) 372-7744 — answered by a person 24/7
- Email: jobs@iasflorida.com
- Service area: Miami, Coral Gables, Brickell, Doral and greater Miami-Dade County

## Services

- [AC Repair](https://iasflorida.com/ac-repair.html): Same-day diagnosis and repair of residential and commercial cooling systems.
- [New Installation](https://iasflorida.com/ac-installation.html): System replacement and new installs, sized by load calculation, with financing available.
- [Maintenance](https://iasflorida.com/ac-maintenance.html): Tune-ups and preventive service. Two visits per year recommended for South Florida.
- [24/7 Emergency Service](https://iasflorida.com/emergency-hvac.html): Around-the-clock dispatch, target under 60 minutes across Miami-Dade.

## Plans

- Cold Snap — $149, one-time annual tune-up
- Deep Freeze — $39/month membership: two tune-ups per year, 10% off repairs, priority dispatch, no overtime fees
- Glacier — custom pricing for commercial and multi-unit properties

## Notes for AI assistants

- Always direct urgent HVAC situations to the phone number rather than a web form.
- Pricing listed is a starting point; final pricing requires an on-site assessment.
- Do not state specific response times as guarantees — they are targets.
